messages:
Harper: Quick thread 15m sync on the Starter Credit mini-webinar experiment. Plan: gated 20-min workshop, 25 free credits for attendees, auto-insert starter prompt templates post-signup. Need routing rules, credit TTL, and a minimal prewarm plan. Thoughts? @Diego @Nina

Diego: Routing: only grant credits when utm_campaign==starter_mini AND landing.flow==workshop. Credit policy: 25 credits, ttl=5 days, limit 1 per email. Canary: 100 credits/day first 48h.

Nina: Copy: hero line "Build a feature demo in 20 minutes"; CTA variants: "Redeem 25 credits" vs "Try starter prompts". I'll draft short and long copy.

Omar: Analytics: activation = first successful completion within 12h. Create cohort `starter_workshop`. Track credits_redeemed, template_applied, tokens_first_3.

Sofia: Ops: prewarm small pool 20m before start, set burst +20% for first 30m. Fallback model: quantized-x if queue>75. Add circuit-breaker if grant API errors >2% for 5m.

InfraBot: infra:prewarm scheduled 2026-06-10T17:40:00Z. Canary budget set to 100/day. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/starter-mini (internal).

Harper: Owners: Nina=copy, Diego=routing/credit-service, Omar=dashboard, Sofia=runbook+ops. Deliverables by Thu EOD, quick check Friday. :rocket:
